def check(condition, category, detail):

def close(a,b,category,detail,tol=1e-10):
    x,y=np.asarray(a),np.asarray(b)
    check(x.shape==y.shape and np.isfinite(x).all() and np.isfinite(y).all() and np.allclose(x,y,atol=tol,rtol=tol),category,detail)

def sha(path):
    path=Path(path); value=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    files[str(path)]=value
    return value

def doc(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()

def load_json(path):
    sha(path)
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())

def load_npz(path):
    sha(path)
    with np.load(path,allow_pickle=False) as z:
        return {k:z[k].item() if z[k].ndim==0 else z[k].copy() for k in z.files}

def data_digest(data):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    for k in sorted(data):
        h.update(k.encode());v=data[k]
        h.update(v.tobytes() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray) else str(v).encode())
    return h.hexdigest()

def feedback_digest(data):
    return doc({k:v.tolist() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray) else v for k,v in data.items()})

def data_check(data,split,seed,n,group,register=True):
    check(data['split']==split and data['seed']==seed and len(data['ids'])==n,'data_identity',group)
    prefix=(f'feedback2:{split}:{seed}:' if group.startswith('feedback') else f'{split}:{data["law"]}:{seed}:')
    check(data['ids'].tolist()==[prefix+str(i) for i in range(n)],'data_identity',group+' IDs')
    if register:
        check(seed not in data_seeds and not set(data['ids'])&data_ids,'data_disjoint',group)
        data_seeds.add(seed);data_ids.update(data['ids'])

def prefix(data,n):
    count=len(data['ids'])
    return {k:v[:n] if isinstance(v,np.ndarray) and v.ndim and len(v)==count else v for k,v in data.items()}

def loss(parameters,pieces):
    pairs=[task.combine_training(x) for x in pieces]
    h={k:np.concatenate([p[0][k] for p in pairs]) for k in pairs[0][0]}
    y=np.concatenate([p[1] for p in pairs]);m,v=learners.predict({'kind':'filter','parameters':parameters},h)
    return float(np.mean(.5*(np.log(2*np.pi*v)+(y-m)**2/v)))
